sections.title: Day 12 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天進入第二週另一個高頻失分區：**時間與條件連接詞**。主攻 `when / before / after / until / once / if / unless`，以及 TOEIC 很愛考的：

> **未來的時間／條件副詞子句中，不使用 will。**

目前沒有收到前幾日的小考實際成績，因此今天維持 **860～900 分難度**，並持續混入 Day 8～11 的分詞、關係詞與連接詞題型。建議訓練約 **90 分鐘**。

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜時間副詞子句
sections.markdown:
看：

> We will contact you **when the order arrives**.

注意：

主句：

> We **will contact** you.

未來式。

但是 when 子句：

> when the order **arrives**

使用：

**現在簡單式**

不是：

> when the order will arrive ❌

這是今天最重要的規則。

當 `when / before / after / until / once` 表達未來時間時：

> **主句可以 will**

但：

> **時間副詞子句使用現在式表未來**

---

sections.title: ③ when
sections.markdown:
> I will call you when the meeting **ends**.

不是：

> when the meeting will end ❌

因此：

> The manager will review the report when she _____ to the office.

(A) will return  
(B) returns  
(C) returned  
(D) returning

答案：

**B**

---

sections.title: ④ before / after
sections.markdown:
> Please check the document before you **submit** it.

> We will begin after everyone **arrives**.

即使事情發生在未來：

> after everyone arrives

仍然不用：

> after everyone will arrive ❌

---

sections.title: ⑤ until
sections.markdown:
`until` = 直到。

> Please wait here until the manager **returns**.

又是：

**現在式表未來。**

TOEIC 高頻：

> The store will remain closed until the renovation **is completed**.

注意這裡又混入 Day 5：

renovation 是「被完成」。

所以：

> **is completed**

現在式 + 被動。

---

sections.title: ⑥ once
sections.markdown:
`once` 在 TOEIC 很常表示：

**一旦……**

例如：

> We will ship your order once payment **is received**.

不是：

> once payment will be received ❌

payment 是「被收到」。

所以：

> **is received**

這種題已經同時考：

**時間連接詞 + 主被動**

---

sections.title: ⑦ 條件句｜if
sections.markdown:
同樣規則：

> If you **submit** the form today, we will process it tomorrow.

不是：

> If you will submit... ❌

標準第一條件句：

> **If + 現在式, will + V**

例如：

> If demand **increases**, the factory will increase production.

---

sections.title: ⑧ unless
sections.markdown:
`unless` 很重要：

> **unless = if ... not**

例如：

> We will cancel the meeting unless the manager arrives.

等於：

> We will cancel the meeting if the manager does not arrive.

所以：

> unless you contact us

= 如果你沒有聯絡我們。

---

## 超高頻例句

> Your reservation will be canceled unless payment _____ by Friday.

(A) receives  
(B) will receive  
(C) is received  
(D) will be received

payment 是：

**被收到**

又在 unless 子句。

所以：

> **is received**

答案：

**C**

這就是 860～900 分題型：一次考兩個規則。

---

sections.title: ⑨ Listening｜Part 2
sections.markdown:
今天加入更多「反問／資訊不足」回答。

### Q1

> When will the new advertising campaign begin?

(A) Once the final design is approved.  
(B) About $30,000.  
(C) The marketing department.

**答案：A**

---

### Q2

> Should we offer customers a larger discount?

(A) What are our competitors offering?  
(B) The promotion ends Friday.  
(C) About two hundred customers.

**答案：A**

要不要打更大折扣？

→ 競爭對手給多少？

合理的決策前置問題。

---

### Q3

> Has the marketing team finished the brochure?

(A) They're waiting for the final photographs.  
(B) About twelve pages.  
(C) At the printing company.

**答案：A**

可以推論：

**還沒完成。**

---

### Q4

> Why hasn't the advertisement been published?

(A) The manager hasn't approved it yet.  
(B) On the company website.  
(C) About three weeks.

**答案：A**

---

### Q5

> Who's conducting the customer survey?

(A) Didn't Maria volunteer to do it?  
(B) About five hundred customers.  
(C) Next Tuesday.

**答案：A**

---

### Q6

> Aren't we launching the product next week?

(A) The launch has been postponed.  
(B) At the convention center.  
(C) About twenty products.

**答案：A**

---

sections.title: ⑩ Reading｜Part 7
sections.markdown:
今天限時：

**3 分鐘。**

> **To:** Sales Team  
> **From:** Marketing Department  
> **Subject:** New Product Promotion
>
> Our advertising campaign for the new HomePro coffee machine will begin on September 21. The campaign will include online advertisements, promotional videos, and product demonstrations at selected retail stores.
>
> Customers who purchase a HomePro machine before October 15 will receive a complimentary package of coffee beans. They will also receive a 20 percent discount on selected accessories if they register their product on our website within seven days of purchase.
>
> Before the campaign begins, all sales representatives must complete the online product training program. The program takes approximately 45 minutes and includes information about product features, pricing, and warranty coverage.
>
> Promotional materials will be delivered to stores once the final designs are approved. Store managers should contact the Marketing Department if the materials have not arrived by September 18.

### Q1

When will the advertising campaign begin?

(A) September 15  
(B) September 18  
(C) September 21  
(D) October 15

### Q2

What will customers receive with qualifying purchases?

(A) Free accessories  
(B) Coffee beans  
(C) An extended warranty  
(D) A discount coupon

### Q3

What must customers do to receive an accessory discount?

(A) Complete a survey  
(B) Visit a retail store  
(C) Register their product  
(D) Purchase two machines

### Q4

What must sales representatives do before the campaign?

(A) Complete training  
(B) Contact customers  
(C) Design promotional materials  
(D) Conduct demonstrations

### Q5

When will promotional materials be delivered?

(A) After the campaign ends  
(B) Once the designs are approved  
(C) Before training begins  
(D) After customers register

### Q6

Why might store managers contact Marketing?

(A) To request training  
(B) To change prices  
(C) Promotional materials have not arrived  
(D) To approve a design

**答案：1C / 2B / 3C / 4A / 5B / 6C**

注意文章：

> Promotional materials will be delivered **once the final designs are approved**.

這就是今天的：

**once + 現在式表未來**

而且：

> designs **are approved**

又是被動。

---

sections.title: ⑬ 今日解析
sections.markdown:
今天最重要的是 Q2。

> The products will be shipped once payment _____.

先看到：

> once

未來時間副詞子句：

**不用 will。**

再看：

> payment

payment 不會「收到別人」。

而是：

**payment 被收到**

所以：

> **is received**

答案 C。

這題同時用了：

**時間副詞子句 + 被動語態。**

---

Q4：

> If customer demand _____, production will be increased.

if 子句描述未來條件。

所以：

> **increases**

不是：

> will increase

---

Q5：

> unless you contact us

等於：

> if you do not contact us

因此：

> The reservation will be canceled **if you do not contact us**.

---

sections.title: ⑭ 錯題複習
sections.markdown:
今天快速回收 Day 9～11。

> The hotel _____ we stayed...

**where**

`we stayed` 完整。

> The hotel _____ we booked...

**which**

`we booked _____` 缺受詞。

> _____ the heavy rain, the event continued.

**Despite**

後面名詞。

> _____ it was raining, the event continued.

**Although**

後面完整句。

> Please remain seated _____ the presentation.

**during**

後面名詞。

> Please remain seated _____ the presentation is in progress.

**while**

後面完整句。

如果這六題現在可以在 **30 秒內全部回答**，第二週的結構辨識進度正常。

---

sections.title: ⑮ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
今天先複習單字搭配：

> advertising campaign  
> special promotion  
> target audience  
> conduct a survey  
> customer feedback  
> brand awareness  
> competitive price  
> product launch

接著把今天七個連接詞直接背成一條時間線：

> **before → when → after → until → once**

再加：

> **if → 如果**

> **unless → 如果不**

接著朗讀五次：

> I'll call you when I **arrive**.

> We'll start after everyone **arrives**.

> We'll ship it once payment **is received**.

> If demand **increases**, we'll increase production.

> We'll cancel the order unless you **contact** us.

不要只看，要真正念出來，讓「副詞子句不用 will」變成語感。

最後睡前重新做 Day 12 小考，第二次限制：

**2 分 30 秒**

目標：

**10/10。**

如果今天能達到 **9～10/10 且 ≤3 分鐘**，Day 13 會繼續提高混合題比例；如果 Q1～Q5 錯超過兩題，後續會保留更多「主句 will + 副詞子句現在式」訓練。

今天最重要的一個反射：

> **看到 when / before / after / until / once / if / unless 描述未來，先把副詞子句裡的 will 拿掉。**

**Day 13** 將進入 **比較級、最高級與 `as...as`，以及 `much / far / significantly + comparative` 的 860+ Part 5 陷阱**，並繼續增加 Part 7 的同義改寫與推論題。

keyTakeaway: when / before / after / until / once / if / unless 描述未來時，副詞子句使用現在式而不用 will。
